verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to version, review, or roll back automations in GA4. The Admin API's change-history search (docs-14) is an adjacent audit feature for property settings, not versioning or rollback of automations. The Data API's automated-reporting claims (docs-3) are developer building blocks, not a managed, versioned automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
